title: lolium × holmbergii
intro: Lolium × holmbergii, commonly known as Holmberg's ryegrass, is a hybrid of Lolium multiflorum and Lolium perenne. It is a type of grass native to Europe and Asia, known for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The plant has been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Lolium × holmbergii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
